scope: Independent finite-vector controls through the actual x86 D3DX9_43 DLL on the recorded Windows reference CPU. Small/zero/signed-zero/axis/diagonal/camera vectors and 8192 seeded random vectors span exponents -100..60. Scalar SSE products/sums, small-vector zeroing and CPU reciprocal-square-root estimate plus refinement are compared bit for bit. Other CPU estimate implementations, nonfinite vectors, GPU pixels and complete gameplay are not certified.
